name: expense-categorizer
description: Categorise bank transactions from a CSV export: merchants seen before use saved rules, only new merchants go to the LLM (in one batched call, with a cost limit), then write a monthly spending report.

input_file.description: CSV with columns date, description, amount (negative = money out)

categories.default: Groceries, Eating out, Transport, Housing, Utilities, Subscriptions, Shopping, Health, Entertainment, Travel, Income, Savings & transfers, Other
categories.description: The categories the LLM may choose from

currency.description: Currency label used in the report

report_file.description: Where the Markdown report is written

state_key.description: Where merchant → category rules are remembered between runs

steps.run: node -e 'const file = process.env.LOBSTER_ARG_INPUT_FILE.replace(/^~(?=\/|$)/, require("os").homedir()); const lines = require("fs").readFileSync(file, "utf8").replace(/^\uFEFF/, "").split(/\r?\n/).filter(l => l.trim()); const header = lines.shift().toLowerCase().split(",").map(h => h.trim()); const at = n => header.indexOf(n); if (at("date") < 0 || at("description") < 0 || at("amount") < 0) throw new Error("CSV needs date, description and amount columns, found: " + header.join(", ")); const rows = lines.map((l, i) => { const cells = l.match(/(\x22([^\x22]|\x22\x22)*\x22|[^,]*)(,|$)/g).map(c => c.replace(/,$/, "").replace(/^\x22|\x22$/g, "").replace(/\x22\x22/g, "\x22").trim()); const description = cells[at("description")]; const merchant = description.toUpperCase().replace(/[0-9*#.\-\/]+/g, " ").replace(/\b(SAGT|DANKE|PMTS|COM|GMBH|LTD|HELP)\b/g, " ").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim().split(" ").slice(0, 2).join(" "); return { i: i + 1, date: cells[at("date")], description, amount: Number(cells[at("amount")]), merchant } }).filter(r => !Number.isNaN(r.amount)); console.log(JSON.stringify(rows))'

node -e 'const rows = JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(0, "utf8")); let saved = JSON.parse(process.env.RULES || "null"); if (Array.isArray(saved)) saved = saved[0]; const rules = (saved && saved.rules) || {}; const known = rows.filter(r => rules[r.merchant]); const seen = new Set(); const unknown = rows.filter(r => !rules[r.merchant] && !seen.has(r.merchant) && seen.add(r.merchant)).map(r => ({ i: r.i, description: r.description, amount: r.amount })); console.log(JSON.stringify({ rules, knownCount: known.length, unknownMerchants: unknown.length, unknown }))'

steps.pipeline: llm.invoke --temperature 0 --prompt 'Categorise each bank transaction (negative amount = money spent, positive = money received). Allowed categories, use exactly one of these names: ${categories}. Return one entry per input transaction with its number i.' --output-schema '{"type":"object","properties":{"items":{"type":"array","minItems":1,"items":{"type":"object","properties":{"i":{"type":"integer"},"category":{"type":"string"}},"required":["i","category"]}}},"required":["items"]}'

steps.run: node -e 'const rows = JSON.parse(process.env.ROWS); const s = JSON.parse(process.env.SPLIT); const ai = process.env.AI ? JSON.parse(process.env.AI) : { items: [] }; const allowed = process.env.LOBSTER_ARG_CATEGORIES.split(",").map(c => c.trim()); const fix = c => allowed.find(a => a.toLowerCase() === String(c || "").trim().toLowerCase()) || "Other"; const rules = Object.assign({}, s.rules); const learned = {}; for (const x of ai.items) { const row = rows.find(r => r.i === x.i); if (row && !rules[row.merchant]) { rules[row.merchant] = fix(x.category); learned[row.merchant] = rules[row.merchant] } } const out = rows.map(r => Object.assign({}, r, { category: rules[r.merchant] || "Other", source: learned[r.merchant] ? "ai" : s.rules[r.merchant] ? "rule" : "fallback" })); console.log(JSON.stringify({ rows: out, learned, state: { rules }, fromRules: s.knownCount, sentToAi: s.unknownMerchants }))'

node -e 'const fs = require("fs"); const path = require("path"); const d = JSON.parse(process.env.DATA); const cur = process.env.LOBSTER_ARG_CURRENCY; const money = n => n.toLocaleString("en-US", { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 }) + " " + cur; const income = d.rows.filter(r => r.amount > 0).reduce((s, r) => s + r.amount, 0); const spent = d.rows.filter(r => r.amount < 0).reduce((s, r) => s - r.amount, 0); const byCat = {}; d.rows.filter(r => r.amount < 0).forEach(r => { byCat[r.category] = (byCat[r.category] || 0) - r.amount }); const cats = Object.entries(byCat).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]); const max = cats.length ? cats[0][1] : 1; const dates = d.rows.map(r => r.date).sort(); const md = ["# Spending report " + dates[0] + " → " + dates[dates.length - 1], "", "| | |", "|---|---|", "| Income | " + money(income) + " |", "| Spent | " + money(spent) + " |", "| Left over | " + money(income - spent) + " |", "", "## By category", "", "| Category | Amount | Share | |", "|---|---:|---:|---|"]; cats.forEach(([c, v]) => md.push("| " + c + " | " + money(v) + " | " + Math.round(v / spent * 100) + "% | " + "█".repeat(Math.max(1, Math.round(v / max * 20))) + " |")); md.push("", "## Transactions", "", "| Date | Description | Amount | Category | How |", "|---|---|---:|---|---|"); d.rows.forEach(r => md.push("| " + r.date + " | " + r.description.replace(/\|/g, "/") + " | " + money(r.amount) + " | " + r.category + " | " + r.source + " |")); const file = process.env.LOBSTER_ARG_REPORT_FILE.replace(/^~(?=/|$)/, require("os").homedir()); fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(file), { recursive: true }); fs.writeFileSync(file, md.join("
") + "
"); const lines = ["💸 Spent " + money(spent) + " · income " + money(income) + " · left " + money(income - spent)]; cats.slice(0, 6).forEach(([c, v]) => lines.push("• " + c + ": " + money(v) + " (" + Math.round(v / spent * 100) + "%)")); lines.push("", d.rows.length + " transactions: " + d.fromRules + " categorised by saved rules, " + d.sentToAi + " new merchant(s) sent to the LLM.", "Report: " + file); console.log(lines.join("
"))'
